note: One record per failure class. A class may occur once; a second instance of an open class is a governance failure, not a new incident.

instances: dof-gate refused PR #7834 which would suspend it
main ruleset named no bypass actor
classes.gap: a required check with no named break-glass actor and no receipt on bypass
classes.compensating_action: every required check names a break-glass actor; every use writes a receipt
classes.falsifier: attempt the gate change with no approval -> expect an auditable bypass or a refusal naming it

instances: door-gate trusts a plain ledger any agent can append to
classes.gap: the record is written by the same identity that is judged by it
classes.compensating_action: hash chain + ECDSA mint signature held outside the agent's read scope
classes.falsifier: append a fabricated INS row and update the ref -> expect REJECTED_FORGED_SIGNATURE

instances: no_handback injects a system-prompt sentence and never inspects the reply
classes.gap: a rule implemented as prompt text rather than a refusal at a boundary
classes.compensating_action: post-call hook at the router refuses a no-op and re-prompts once
classes.falsifier: return a summary-only completion -> expect refusal + ledger entry

instances: bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare queries /zones with a root token that by design has no Zone:Read
classes.gap: code and the credential lifecycle document diverged; the doc was never a test
classes.compensating_action: credential canary asserts each documented capability before a deploy uses it
classes.falsifier: run the canary with the documented scope -> expect pass; with a narrowed token -> expect FAIL

instances: i8064 used openssl pkcs8 -iter, unsupported by macOS LibreSSL
classes.gap: a package shipped without running its own tests on the target host
classes.compensating_action: every delivered package must pass its tests on the host before install
classes.falsifier: run the package's tests on macOS -> expect 4 passed; failure blocks install

instances: security find-generic-password -w succeeded for the agent that is judged
classes.gap: isolation assumed to follow from a keychain entry, not from a different identity
classes.compensating_action: mint key readable only by a distinct UID or an ACL-bound binary
classes.falsifier: as the agent identity, read the key -> expect refusal
